summary_md: **Fayaz Ahmed ([@fayazara](https://x.com/fayazara/status/2115796942110519584))** releases **Screendrop v0.37.0**, which lets Claude Code, Codex and other MCP clients trim, cut words and silences, import media and export recordings, plus an editable capture area, new cursor styles and a rebuilt Studio timeline ([release notes](https://github.com/fayazara/Screendrop/releases/tag/v0.37.0)).
relevance: Screen-recording editor exposed to agents over MCP.
